about.text: A dark fried sweet made from chhana or khoa, listed among Bangladeshi chhana sweets. A 2004 study describes it as deep-fried until nearly black, then soaked in sugar syrup.

sources.text: The 2004 study by Shahnaz et al., which gives the method, and a 2025 paper that lists kalojam among Bangladeshi chhana sweets.
